input_text: Elmsworth Car Credit - drive your next car on Hire Purchase, direct from the lender. Representative example: cash price £10,490; advance payment £2,495; total amount of credit £7,995; rate of interest 11.9% per annum, fixed; option-to-purchase fee £10; duration of agreement 48 months; 47 monthly repayments of £209 and a final repayment of £219 (including the £10 option-to-purchase fee); total amount payable £12,537; representative APR 12.4%. Elmsworth Car Credit Ltd, 20 Foundry Lane, Coventry CV1 5FB.

claims.claim: The stated repayment amounts are accompanied by a representative example containing the required items and a postal address
claims.rationale: The cost-of-credit amounts are accompanied by an example labelled 'Representative example' containing each item CONC 3.5.5R(1)(a)-(h) requires (rate of interest and that it is fixed, the other charge and its amount, total amount of credit, representative APR, cash price and advance payment, duration, total amount payable, amount of each repayment), plus the postal address CONC 3.5.3R(1)(b) requires.

label_authority.source: FCA Handbook, CONC 3.5.3R
label_authority.quote: Where a financial promotion indicates a rate of interest or an amount relating to the cost of credit whether expressed as a sum of money or a proportion of a specified amount, the financial promotion must also: (a) include a representative example in accordance with CONC 3.5.5 R, and (b) specify a postal address at which the person making the financial promotion may be contacted.

notes: The sums are internally consistent (47x£209 + £219 + £2,495 = £12,537; cash price = advance + credit) - what a human must verify is the rate of interest (11.9%) and representative APR (12.4%), which are plausible-not-computed; the equal/no-less-prominence limbs of CONC 3.5.5R(5) are not assessable from plain text (gold-125 carries that question).
